mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not decline for 3 consecutive months, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises above 3.5% in a month, it signals weakening labor market conditions, triggering negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross above 3.5% in a month, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (quarterly demand) and HOUST (monthly demand) signals robust demand growth, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: both proxies increase in the same month
failure_condition: Neither proxy increases in the same month, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns by lowering borrowing costs and boosting equity valuations.
failure_condition: The regime is not a tightening cycle, or FEDFUNDS do not decline for 3 months, or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in INDPRO (monthly supply index) indicates expanding production capacity, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not increase for 6 consecutive months, or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO rises above 110, it signals strong supply growth, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through improved market confidence.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not cross 110, or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in PAYEMS (employment) alongside a decline in UNRATE (unemployment) signals a strengthening labor market, triggering negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to inflationary pressures.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases AND UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: Either proxy moves oppositely, or returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous rises in GDPC1 and HOUST predict positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as demand outpaces supply constraints.
failure_condition: The regime is not late-cycle, or proxies do not rise simultaneously, or returns are not positive.
